intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}. This page compares recorded year fees, 2023 placements and the ranks we hold, with official sites opened in {{year}}.
Amity University Haryana vs NorthCap University is a Gurugram integrated-law comparison. We have not multiplied the year fees into a five-year total.

sections.heading: Amity University Haryana vs NorthCap University for Integrated Law: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Amity University Haryana if you want recorded year tuition of ₹2.06 lakh, a 2023 BBA LLB (Hons) row of ₹4 lakh average and ₹8 lakh highest, and a NIRF 2025 rank of 39 recorded against integrated law.
Choose NorthCap University if you want a recorded Total Fees year figure of ₹1.64 lakh for BBA LLB, and a 2023 row of ₹4 lakh average and ₹6 lakh highest, after official confirmation.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For Amity University Haryana we hold year tuition of ₹2.06 lakh on the listed integrated-law rows. That is tuition for one year, not a confirmed official five-year total.
For NorthCap University we hold ₹1.64 lakh as a Total Fees year figure for BBA LLB. We have not multiplied it either.
Confirm the current five-year notices on the official Amity Haryana and ncuindia.edu pages before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Amity University Haryana has a 2023 BBA LLB (Hons) row of ₹4 lakh average and ₹8 lakh highest. NorthCap University has a 2023 BBA LLB row of ₹4 lakh average and ₹6 lakh highest.
These are historical records for those programmes, not a promise for every integrated-law stream. Ask both campuses for a later official law-school report.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: No entrance exam is mapped on this page. Follow each university's official integrated-law admissions process.
On our records, Amity University Haryana has a NIRF 2025 rank of 39 and a NIRF 2024 rank of 33, recorded against integrated law, plus India Today ranks of 30 in 2024 and 34 in 2023.
NorthCap University has no rank row here. Confirm the current NIRF list on nirfindia.org.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are private universities recorded in Gurugram, Haryana, so a local student can visit them on the same trip.
Amity University Haryana lists BA LLB (Hons), BBA LLB (Hons) and B.Com LLB (Hons). NorthCap University is listed here with BBA LLB. Match the exact five-year course.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick Amity University Haryana if the NIRF 2025 rank of 39 and the wider recorded course list matter more, after official fee confirmation.
Pick NorthCap University if the recorded ₹1.64 lakh year fee and that campus fit you, after you have a written official five-year notice.
Do not multiply either year fee into a five-year total we have not confirmed.
